name: primitive
description: Email infrastructure for AI agents. Skills to send, receive, and reply to email, run code on inbound mail, set up custom domains and webhooks, plus Primitive's hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Email infrastructure for AI agents in Codex
interface.longDescription: Primitive bundles its hosted MCP server with skills to send email and await the threaded reply, receive and read mail at a managed *.primitive.email address, run code on inbound mail, and set up custom domains and webhooks, with no SMTP, DNS, or mail server. The same server backs Primitive's ChatGPT app and Claude connector.
capabilities: Send email and await the threaded reply
Receive and read inbound email at a managed address
Search inbound email and pull full conversation threads
interface.defaultPrompt: Send an email and wait for the reply with Primitive.
